draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.85, the 190th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 28th of 35 at WR. He went 157th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (190th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 345 receiving yards in 2020, 30th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers (practice squad). 48 career games and 1 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2024 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: receiving yards 0 (1st percentile), receiving td 0 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 0 receiving yards against a median of 302, below the norm.
